This class provides some static methods for the creation of custom views inside the Bio7 application.

    • setFullscreen

      public void setFullscreen(boolean fullscreen)
      Displays the view in fullscreen mode or returns to the view. Several views can be displayed in fullscreen mode, one per monitor (another view on the monitor is replaced). The fullscreen mode can also be toggled with the F2 key and closed with the ESC key.
      Parameters:
      fullscreen - true to display the view in fullscreen mode.

    • setFullscreen

      public void setFullscreen(int monitor)
      Displays the view in fullscreen mode on the given monitor or moves the fullscreen mode to the monitor. The monitors are numbered with the primary monitor first (0: primary, 1: secondary, 2: tertiary monitor, etc.). If the monitor is not available the view is displayed on the monitor of the view.
      Parameters:
      monitor - the index of the monitor.

    • isFullscreen
